name: haroom_plugins
description: haroom Claude Code plugins - ddaro, prism, triad, mangchi, galmuri

plugins.name: ddaro
plugins.description: 0.10.0: opt-in merge gate (merge_gate off|warn|strict; strict turns /ddaro:check into a scripted gate - tests, then a prism --run-tag review whose PASS is tied to the commit SHA - and a PreToolUse hook refuses gh pr merge without --match-head-commit + a PASS for that head, base pushes, write gh api and model-side changes to the gate's files; needs prism 0.6.0+). Worktree-based parallel workflow for Claude Code sessions with a lifecycle conductor (new in 0.6.0: /ddaro:spec scaffolds a design doc + captures decisions, /ddaro:review fires prism (design lenses on docs, --diff on code) + triad (docs) and collates findings, /ddaro:check is a pre-merge prism + ship-checklist gate - pure orchestration over the doc-template/prism-all/triad skills, filling the design->review front half before the existing commit->CI-merge back half; 0.6.1 adds /ddaro:go, a single conductor that reads the worktree's lifecycle stage and runs the next step - spec/review/check stay as the manual gears), plugin-native protective hooks (new in 0.5.0) and dev-cycle orchestration (0.4.0). The seven hooks (main_protection, branch_naming, cross_worktree_check, branch_worktree_match, evidence_check + the two SessionStart reporters) ship in hooks/hooks.json and activate automatically when ddaro is enabled - config-gated and fail-open, so non-ddaro projects see zero noise and nothing is written to .claude/settings.json (run /ddaro:config migrate once to clean up pre-0.5.0 installs). 6-tier classification (main / owned / adopted / protected / unmanaged / external), /ddaro:adopt, cwd-safe destructive commands (clear/abandon from main only). /ddaro:commit opt-in --verify flag (verify.json + CLAUDE.md fallback discovery). /ddaro:merge drives the PR path through CI: state machine, polling, hard-capped fix loop (default 3, configurable), CI_STUCK detection, idempotency guard, confirm gate, sync-main content-diff preview, --force-with-lease invariant. Korean triggers: /ddaro, 따로, 병렬로. English: /ddaro, parallel, isolated.

plugins.name: prism
plugins.description: Evidence-graded multi-angle review (0.6.1) - code gets 5 defect lenses, design docs get 4 design lenses (conflict & reuse / claim accuracy / devil's advocate / robustness); an Evidence pass pins every candidate to file/lines/execution-path; --reproduce demonstrates failures in a temp dir; --redteam adds the attacker-mindset lens absorbed from prism-devil. New in 0.5.0: an idea pass after every review - grounded alternatives (class / route / subtract) gated by a script and judged by a checker that did not write them, listed apart from findings (--no-ideas to skip); the Improvement lens is retired. Codex calls go through a script (codex-run.sh) that enforces the safety preamble, secret scrub and output contract, in the read-only sandbox. Agreement prioritizes, evidence confirms. Pair with triad for how a document reads. New in 0.6.0: a gate run (/prism --run-tag, for ddaro's merge gate) whose prism-report.json a script assembles (assemble-report.js begin/finish, report contract 2), quotes checked at a commit (verify-evidence.js --rev), and the idea pass outcome written by the same script in every review skill. 0.6.1: the shared safety core of codex-run.sh (placeholders, fail-closed scan, lock, scratch sweep, interrupts, cleanup reporting) ported back from triad 0.3.3, the same block as mangchi 0.4.2. Ships /prism, /prism-codex, /prism-all, /prism-ideas.

plugins.name: triad
plugins.description: 3-perspective deliberation on one document (0.3.3) - LLM clarity / architectural longevity / end-user comprehension - parallel subagents until consensus. Documents only: triad checks whether a doc is well written, prism's design lenses check whether the design is sound; code goes to prism (review) or mangchi (fix). Ships /triad, /triad-codex, /triad-all. Codex lenses run through codex-run.sh (safety preamble, secret scrub, read-only sandbox; one output contract for both engines).

plugins.name: mangchi
plugins.description: Iterative cross-model code refinement (0.4.2) - Claude patches, Codex CLI reviews one axis per round (5 default + necessity/robustness opt-in) with a verification loop, until the code converges. Robustness is the single owner of concurrency findings; stateful code gets an auto hint. Codex calls run through codex-run.sh (safety preamble, secret scrub, read-only sandbox, YAML schema and citation gates as code).

plugins.name: galmuri
plugins.description: Distill reusable, project-agnostic techniques (hooks, rules, guards, structural patterns) from a project into portable technique cards in a knowledge repo - so the know-how survives without the project. The companion /forge turns a skill-shaped card back into a verified Claude Code skill (classify card shape, scaffold SKILL.md, gate on 9 quality criteria). Korean trigger: 갈무리.
